title: boehmeria frutescens var. viridula
intro: Boehmeria frutescens var. viridula, commonly known as Wild Ginseng or Rau Ma, is a perennial plant native to Southeast Asia, characterized by its edible and medicinal properties. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Boehmeria frutescens var. viridula include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, lower blood pressure, and improve digestion, making it a valuable remedy in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
